_about: Mars overlay, deep-merged over data/tuning.json (src/gameData.ts, rules/merge.ts). Keys starting with _ are notes and are dropped; null removes a shared key. Sections not listed here are the Moon's. Types: rules/types.ts Tuning, rules/marsTypes.ts.
_placeholder: Values listed under a section's _placeholder are stubs for the track named there. Values under _interface are set with Owner A.

mission._note: Decided: 10 sols in 10 minutes. gameDays counts sols on Mars. gravity: Mars surface gravity, m/s^2.

payout._interface: survivalPayout: Mars survival payout, Owner A sets it (placeholder: the Moon value). The Titan pass mark is budget.minimumBudget.titan in data/tuning.json (placeholder 0).

rover._placeholder: gravityScale keeps the ground gravity the Moon's handling was tuned for (3.71 x 1.75 = 6.5 m/s^2, the Moon's 1.62 x 4); airGravityScale stays the time-lapse value (16 x the world's gravity). Integration (M6) and verification tune these on the real terrain.

sun._placeholder: Stand-in until the rules track (M3) adds the real Jezero Sun path on the sol clock: the lunar model with the Sun fixed near noon at Ls 200 (subsolar longitude = site longitude, solar declination -8.4 deg), so the placeholder world stays lit.

cold._note: No cold zones on Mars: the night cold is map-wide (tuning.night, rules track M3).

survey._note: Orbital survey leads (M5): the delta front (deltaFront, aimed at its nearest point), Seitah (seitah) and the first rocky area in terrain.json (rockyAreas.0, so the lead survives the pipeline renaming it). Text in data/mars/text.json survey.leads. Rounding is the Moon's.

milestones._note: M5. Mars zones: the delta front (deltaFront.zoneRadius_m from terrain.json), Seitah's outline, and photoZoneRadiusM circles around the deltaLayers and sunset viewpoints. Samples: the Moon's 200 m from the lander and from each other. No hydrogen signal (no ice on Mars).
milestones._sunset: Blue sunset: the setting Sun's center between sunsetMinElevationDeg and sunsetMaxElevationDeg, in frame and not hidden by terrain, at least sunsetPhotoMinDistanceM from the lander (the Sun sets in view of the lander every sol). With the rules track's eased Sun near the horizon (about 1.5 deg/s), 0 to 10 deg lasts about 6 s per dusk; widen the band here if playtests find it too tight.

sol._note: Decided (game-design.md, The Mars mission): 10 sols of 60 s, 45 s of day then 15 s of night, season Ls about 200. Owner: rules track (M3).

night._placeholder: Rules track (M3) sets every value here. Interface: freeze rate per night (Owner B) against heater strength and draw (Owner A).
